extracted.name: Fries Seasoning
extracted.description: This is a simple but super tasty seasoning for French fries that adds more flavour than using just plain salt. Preferably homemade - but even store bought frozen fries or wedges! Also use to add extra flavour to cooked things like roast vegetables, potatoes and cooked proteins.Makes enough for a double batch of homemade fries.
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp onion powder ((or more garlic powder))
1 tsp garlic powder ((or more onion powder))
instruction_lines: Store any leftovers in an airtight container or jar in the pantry. Also great on roast potatoes, vegetables and proteins (use for cooking or sprinkle as a finishing salt).
